title: DuckStation 0.1-11443: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11443 on June 28, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11443 on June 28, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: 2b1a6cf2b Qt: More appropriate icon for "Search on Redump" button. a90182445 Qt: Improve icon consistency. 15d8f68d3 Merge pull request 3747 from Pesa/overlap. 00149a5be Qt: Disable buttons if controller port is empty ( 3748).
